title: Screen capture with HTML annotation tools in one canvas
blurb: A telestrator. The screen, the camera or a clip is the video in a canvas. Pen strokes, arrows, notes, a magnifier, a spotlight and a redact box are DOM elements over it, and the canvas goes out as one stream.
question: Can a screen capture be the video under HTML annotation tools in one drawable canvas, with the annotations made of DOM, and can the result be sent on as one stream and recorded?
result: Yes. The capture is a <video> like any other, the annotations are SVG paths and form controls that keep working, and the redaction is in the stream. A capture cropped to the canvas itself is a closed loop.
